summary: Classify one dynamic op by setting its effect and/or approval.

input_schema.op_id: string | required | dynamic op id to classify (e.g. eventkit--list-events).
input_schema.words: array<string> | required | one or more words drawn from the effect set (read|write|execute|external) and/or the approval set (always|never).

output_schema: string | Confirmation message describing the persisted classification.

slash_command.name: op-classify
slash_command.description: classify a dynamic op (effect and/or approval)
